established.finding: completionProvider:{} is sufficient for static completion support. resolveProvider is a separate predicate used for resolve only. No compiler capability workaround warranted.

Contributor is registered for language=any, order first,before wordCompletion. TextMate presence is not a prerequisite or blanket exclusion. Contributor can return before request when virtualFile absent or ProjectIndexingManager result not NOW.

Default completion feature isEnabled returns true. User-defined completion subclass only customizes context-aware sorting (default false) and invocation-only snippet templates (default true), not a completion-enabled switch. No verified completion enable checkbox should be invented.

Completion future cancellation returns without items; successful results require normal completion. Blank labels are ignored. Prefix matching follows textEdit-derived prefix when present, otherwise existing IntelliJ prefix matcher.
